 Motorola officially teases new phone in dark green finish
 Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 05:30 
 Photo source: Notebookcheck 
 A teaser and a Flipkart microsite point to the Edge 70 Neo, which Motorola previously said would launch in India. Its launch date and full specifications have yet to be revealed. 
 Motorola has posted a teaser for an upcoming phone on its official X account. A new Flipkart microsite uses the phrase "neo era," suggesting the device is the Edge 70 Neo. Motorola previously confirmed at IFA 2026 that the Edge 70 Neo would launch in India.
 This is reported by Notebookcheck .
 The teaser shows the phone in a dark green finish. Its square rear camera module appears to house two cameras, and the phone carries branding for a 50MP LYTIA camera with optical image stabilization (OIS) and Ultra HDR.
 Advertisement 
 The Edge 70 Neo previously appeared on Geekbench 7 with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset, 6GB of RAM and Android 16. A previous leak points to a 7,000mAh battery with 45W charging, a 2MP macro camera and a 32MP front camera.
 For comparison, the Edge 60 Neo, currently $625 on Amazon, has a 3x telephoto camera, a Dimensity 7400 chipset and a 5,000mAh battery. The exact launch date and full specifications for the Edge 70 Neo have yet to be revealed. It has also yet to be confirmed whether the phone will be available in markets outside India.
